| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | Most provinces & territories (except Quebec) | Apr 7–9 2023 |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | All provinces except Quebec | May 20–22 2023 |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | All provinces & territories | Jul 1–3 2023 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | All provinces & territories | Sep 2–4 2023 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | All provinces & territories | Oct 7–9 2023 |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Saturday) | All provinces & territories | Nov 11–13 2023 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | All provinces & territories | Dec 23–25 2023 |
